boundary_notes: Theatre walls/trim extend slightly outside the registration box.
Port service threshold reaches X -120 m and is clamped to the 240 m beam.

reference_visual_read.inspection_status: Both supplied PNGs and rendered atlas page 13 were visually inspected by this audit.
theatre_image_observations: Warm cream/ivory textured stone columns and broad arch/soffit surfaces; restrained gold/brass edge details.
Saturated rust/orange curtains, recessed wall fields and upholstered curved audience rows.
Stacked curved balcony fronts with slim transparent/open rail sections, shaped solid ends, planting and visible circulation behind.
Tall, framed proscenium with layered curtains; planetary scenic composition and suspended warm light elements.
Warm linear reveals at balcony/soffit edges, wall sconces and illuminated steps establish a hierarchy that leads to the stage.
Foyer approach and balcony-lounge insets show usable public edges, seating, planting and staff/guest scale cues.
Presentation uses visibly stylized pixel/dither-like texture; component silhouette, trim and lights need to remain readable at game scale.
requirements_inferred_for_the_four_compo: Carry a restrained shared theatre palette and readable curved/recessed architectural rhythm into public components.
Keep useful light on route edges and at the working surface while preserving stage/screen emphasis.
Give acoustic/display and backstage fixtures unmistakably different working forms; colour changes to generic care panels are insufficient.
Treat the reference as a visual target to interpret within existing geometry, not as authority to rebuild the seating plan.
illustrative_plan_traps: Reference legend names stage, orchestra, lower balcony, upper balcony, royal boxes and foyer access. These are image annotations, not extra registered rooms, tiers or numbered places.
Do not replace the documented four-block numbered rows with an unverified radial layout merely because the illustration curves.
Do not import reference columns, balcony depths, arches or decorative braces into clear aisles or structural voids without real support/sightline checks.
No seat width/pitch, door mechanism, acoustic coefficient, material fire rating or species body dimensions can be measured reliably from this perspective illustration.

four_proposed_component_roles.status: Proposed role, not a placed or acoustically certified object
four_proposed_component_roles.function: A shallow architectural return that presents venue/programme information toward the foyer and a ribbed or baffled acoustic-facing surface toward the auditorium.
four_proposed_component_roles.candidate_context: Inside an existing theatre/cinema foyer or side-wall allocation after host geometry inspection; no assigned coordinate.
four_proposed_component_roles.form_direction: A thickened return with separated recessed programme face, visible acoustic ribs/baffles, restrained brass edging and a low-glare warm reveal. Express two functional faces and a real wall/foot connection.
critical_traps: Must not thicken the 5.2/4.8 m nominal portal inward, occupy the door pocket or block a turn.
Keep display glow out of audience sightlines and avoid per-instance real lights.
Do not advertise unapproved showtimes or call visual baffles measured acoustic treatment.
A return does not create a new room, door, service access or capacity.
reference_basis: theatre_image:layered stone/orange recesses and warm edge lighting

four_proposed_component_roles.status: Proposed public-facing station; no ticketing implementation claim
four_proposed_component_roles.function: A compact identifiable staff point for wayfinding, programme handling and queue guidance at an existing foyer edge.
four_proposed_component_roles.candidate_context: A supported level foyer/side-aisle edge outside protected arrival, turning, lift, stair and cinema crossover paths.
four_proposed_component_roles.form_direction: A small counter/lectern with a clear working surface, integrated programme rack, modest task source, reachable public face and tidy staff storage; public finish rather than medical-cabinet language.
critical_traps: Queue footprint and staff approach are part of placement, not spare space inside a cart lane.
Reach heights and knees/limbs are unverified for all six species.
No assumed paid ticket transaction, new crew count, new room ID or extra spectator place.
D11_greenroom is historically public-tagged; a station does not silently make it staff-only.

four_proposed_component_roles.status: Proposed reusable seat/end asset; actual adjustment mechanism and body acceptance pending
four_proposed_component_roles.function: A low-complexity seat and row-end system that can be configured around existing numbered seat anchors and expose a readable aisle end.
four_proposed_component_roles.candidate_context: Exactly one existing numbered place per seat. End pieces are attached furniture, not added admissions or reserve places.
four_proposed_component_roles.form_direction: Economical contoured pad/back, explicit base/fixing support, restrained arm/end parts and configurable support clearances. Limit hidden geometry and repeated high-frequency details.
critical_traps: Do not move, merge, duplicate or renumber entertainment_seats; never write the meal-only seats key.
Keep rows, aisles, transfer substitutions, anchors, sightlines and rake floor contact; pitch/width and final collisions remain unknown.
No default Human fit can certify Munko four-arm clearance, Baelin cartilage support, Mantelid appendages, Koblin stature or Mindo hardware.
Do not add a scripted mechanism, light, high-poly text label or unique material for every one of 3,400 possible instances.
No trial fit in an isolated asset scene proves host crowd or rendering performance.

four_proposed_component_roles.status: Proposed distinct backstage working fixture; exact placement, wiring and cue integration pending
four_proposed_component_roles.function: A shielded aimable work light with a small cue/work surface and controlled cable route for staff stage preparation.
four_proposed_component_roles.candidate_context: A verified supported backstage/workshop position; named D11_service can host workshop intent but does not establish a direct stage-wing link.
four_proposed_component_roles.form_direction: A stable base, slender post, visible hinge/yoke, hooded lamp, compact cue shelf and contained cable path. Practical cooler structure with a warm task pool distinguishes it from public carved returns and care panels.
critical_traps: Base, adjustment sweep and cable slack may not enter egress, curtain, prop, stage-ramp or cart paths.
Prevent audience glare; emissive appearance alone is not proven work illumination.
Support, stability and anchors are unverified; do not claim pressure-vessel or professional stage certification.
No inferred power outlet, wiring port, rigging load, cue protocol or new Mindo charging interface.
